beats.text: You integrated Google's new model three weeks ago. It is already last generation.
beats.show_cue: The Google AI Studio model selector held on Gemini 3.7 Flash next to the 3.6 entry.

beats.text: Google dropped Gemini 3.7 Flash exactly 21 days after 3.6 Flash. To make sure you switch, they cut the price fifty percent to 75 cents per million input tokens.
beats.show_cue: Google's developer pricing table showing the promotional 50% discount banner.

beats.text: On benchmarks, Google claims DeepSWE jumped from 49 to 65 percent, and Code Arena Elo hit 1588. A token is the taxi meter AI bills you on, and Google wants to drive the cheapest cab in town.
beats.show_cue: The DeepSWE benchmark chart comparison between 3.6 and 3.7 Flash.

beats.text: The catch. That fifty percent cut is an introductory rate through December. Come January, your bill doubles back to normal.
beats.show_cue: The pricing footnote highlighting the January price expiration.

beats.text: Test the speed on your tough prompts, but budget for the real price, not the honeymoon discount.
beats.show_cue: Operator on camera, developer dashboard in corner inset.

beats.text: Did AI change your week? Tell us how.
beats.show_cue: Straw Motion logo end card, clean background.
